SELECT map_id, src_text, code_grp_id, code FROM TB_SY_CODE_MAP WHERE src_text=#{excelText} AND code_grp_id=#{groupId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_CODE c JOIN TB_SY_CODE_GRP g ON g.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id WHERE c.code_grp_id=#{groupId} AND c.code=#{code} AND c.del_yn='N' AND c.use_yn='Y' AND g.use_yn='Y' )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SY_CODE_MAP (src_text, code_grp_id, code, reg_user_id, reg_dttm) VALUES (#{excelText}, #{groupId}, #{code}, 'admin', clock_timestamp())
